cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(yoake_motion LANGUAGES CXX)
find_package(OpenCV REQUIRED COMPONENTS core imgproc video calib3d)
add_library(yoake-motion SHARED bridge.cpp motion_track_engine.cpp)
target_compile_features(yoake-motion PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_compile_definitions(yoake-motion PRIVATE WITH_OPENCV)
target_link_libraries(yoake-motion PRIVATE ${OpenCV_LIBS})
target_include_directories(yoake-motion PRIVATE ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS})
add_executable(yoake-motion-test bridge_test.cpp)
target_compile_features(yoake-motion-test PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_link_libraries(yoake-motion-test PRIVATE yoake-motion)
